name: The Chapel School Summer Program
description_short: Summer program at The Chapel School in Bronxville for ages 3 to 12: a nine week Care Bear Camp for 3 to 6 year olds with themed learning, crafts and water play, and morning and afternoon Explorer programs for older children such as basketball, musical theater, robotics, cooking, art and tennis. Families book 1 to 9 weeks.
notes: Lunch is included for full day campers. CARE programs can extend the day. The Explorer programs are described as for children entering 1st through 8th grade, while the page gives ages 3 to 12 for the whole program. 2026 dates and prices are in a brochure the fetcher could not open.

The 2026 brochure (an Adobe link) and the ACTIVE registration page both timed out in the fetcher. Religious affiliation from the school's motto about Christ.
